resources.string: Log selected habits from your home screen. Resize for more habits and swipe vertically through extra pages.
Today’s habit logs, Focus app opens, screen time and daily limits, with a seven-day activity chart.
Add this widget to see your daily activity.
Register Tapwell as a device administrator. Direct NFC control additionally requires managed-device owner or system-app status and secure-settings permission.
Lock chosen apps and the YouTube Shorts player.
Tapwell uses the foreground app name to enforce your locks and reads YouTube’s visible controls to identify the Shorts player. Tapwell does not save screen contents or send them off your device.
